preconditions.description: The size of the set S is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= 10**6 for s_i in S)
preconditions.description: Each element in the set S is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i] < S[i+1] for i in range(len(S)-1))
preconditions.description: The elements of the set S are given in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(sequence) > 0 and len(sequence) <= 4000 and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in sequence))
postconditions.description: If there is no solution, print '-1'. Otherwise, print the length of the sequence followed by the sequence itself, where each element is between 1 and 10^6 and the length does not exceed 4000.

postconditions.expression: set(gcd(a_i, a_i + 1, ..., a_j) for i in range(len(sequence)) for j in range(i, len(sequence))) == set(S)
postconditions.description: The set of gcd values for all subarrays of the sequence must match the set S.
